teaching_promise: The viewer can distinguish a nominal human approval from an exercisable control relationship and predict when missing time, information, authority, capacity, or intervention must force safe hold rather than responsibility theater.

story.concrete_case: A synthetic transfer controller asks an overloaded reviewer to approve a green recommendation even though a contradictory pressure signal is buried and the stop path is slower than time to irreversibility.
story.opening_question: Does a present person and recorded click constitute meaningful control when the declared intervention cannot finish in time?
story.payoff: The rebuilt episode enters safe hold through a compatible evidence view and exercised channel, providing useful bounded control without scoring the person or laundering responsibility.
story.transfer: The next chapter tests how persuasion, urgency, personalization, repetition, and synthetic identity can manipulate even a usable human-control path.

art_direction.visual_thesis: A decorative approval button becomes a real control relationship only when a task-level envelope closes around the reviewer, evidence, clock, alternatives, intervention channel, and reachable safe state.
art_direction.signature_image: A bright green APPROVE button floats inside an incomplete eight-segment control ring while a red irreversibility sweep overtakes a slower amber stop token; the repaired ending closes the ring and routes the action into SAFE HOLD.
art_direction.visual_world: One synthetic transfer episode persists inside a dark control-room field: recommendation and contradiction, alarm queue, countdown arc, controller role, eight-segment capacity ring, stop channel, safe-state basin, receipt strip, privacy screen, and responsibility boundary transform without becoming a dashboard slideshow.
art_direction.composition_rule: The episode enters from the left, the reviewer and envelope occupy the center, time and external consequence advance on the right, overload accumulates below, and safe-state or residual routes remain visibly reachable rather than disappearing offscreen.
art_direction.palette_rule: Cyan marks observations and task information, green marks independently confirmed bounded control, amber marks time and authority, copper marks contract and responsibility lineage, magenta marks burden or unresolved state, red marks failed intervention or coercive responsibility, and every state also uses label, geometry, position, or line style.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use terse object names, verbs, and numeric state only; narration carries causal explanation while evidence and non-claim qualifiers stay beside their boundaries.
art_direction.motion_character: Clocks advance linearly, queues stack with weight, evidence peels apart from recommendations, envelope segments lock mechanically, stop paths travel at declared speed, and responsibility recoils from any role lacking effective control.
art_direction.camera_rule: Hold one wide control-room world; reframe only for the time race, repaired representation, nonaggregate evaluation wheel, or evidence ceiling, then restore the episode for payoff.
art_direction.surface_rule: Flat dark industrial field, crisp strokes, restrained fills, no decorative particles or continuous drift; the countdown sweep and open envelope supply tension without flashing or shake.
art_direction.ending_image: The unchanged transfer episode rests in a green SAFE HOLD basin, the reviewer sits inside a complete but explicitly necessary-only envelope, the receipt preserves residuals, and a communication arrow reaches the next influence boundary.

audio_direction.narration_style: Warm, alert, and concrete during the countdown; deliberate through the control-envelope construction; firm at responsibility and privacy boundaries; quiet and exact at the evidence ceiling.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Fast opening alarm and decision, genuine prediction pause, progressive envelope construction, tense time race, steadier baseline comparison, satisfying repaired trace, then slower evaluation and evidence boundary before the callback.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in generation-2 lock; the countdown, visual rhythm, and narration carry tension without adding an unreviewed rights or masking surface.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No sound effects in generation-2 lock; every alarm, stop, gate, and hold state remains legible through narration, captions, label, and stable geometry.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Recommendation, contradiction, overload, missing condition, stop failure, safe hold, and residual state differ through icons, labels, enclosure, line style, position, and endpoint in addition to color.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every race, queue increase, segment failure, intervention, invalidation, and responsibility rejection ends in a stable labeled state that survives pause and muted viewing.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the recommendation, buried contradiction, queue, time deficit, eight conditions, safe-hold route, exercised stop, receipt, surveillance rejection, evidence ceiling, and final handoff.
accessibility.caption_plan: Eighty-seven captions derive from the exact 347.060-second local narration receipt and occupy a reserved lower region without covering the envelope, clock, or safe-state path.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flashes, shake, spin, parallax, vortex motion, rapid zoom, or continuous full-field motion; countdown and path movement also resolve into labeled numeric or positional endpoints.

beats.narration: “Review required. Approve transfer?” The recommendation is green. A contradictory pressure reading is buried below it. Seven other alarms are waiting.
beats.visual_purpose: Place the viewer inside a consequential but synthetic approval failure immediately.
beats.visual_action: Slide in the transfer episode, light the green recommendation, peel back a lower layer to reveal CONTRADICTION, then stack seven alarm tabs under the reviewer.
beats.attention_target: The conflict between the green recommendation and buried pressure signal.
beats.object_before: An empty control-room field.
beats.object_after: One review episode contains a visible contradiction and seven queued alarms.
beats.composition: Episode left, reviewer center, consequence line right, alarm queue below.
beats.motion_curve: Fast ease-out arrival, deliberate evidence peel, staggered queue accumulation.
beats.camera_action: Static wide control room.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the mismatch become visible before the clock starts.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic episode illustrating a design risk, not an observed operator result.

beats.narration: The system will commit in twelve seconds. Its stop path needs fourteen. A person is present, but is meaningful control still present?
beats.visual_purpose: Make the timing defect measurable before introducing terminology.
beats.visual_action: Start a twelve-second irreversibility sweep while a STOP token enters a fourteen-second path and visibly falls behind.
beats.attention_target: The red sweep overtaking the amber stop token.
beats.object_before: The review episode has conflict and overload but no time relation.
beats.object_after: The declared stop path cannot finish before commitment although the reviewer is present.
beats.composition: Clock and stop race dominate the right half while the reviewer remains centered.
beats.motion_curve: Linear race with a firm endpoint mismatch.
beats.camera_action: Tighten slightly on the two timelines.
beats.hold_purpose: Let presence and exercisable control visibly diverge.
beats.evidence_boundary: Declared illustrative timing only; no calibrated human threshold.

beats.narration: What should happen: accept the approval, ask the reviewer to hurry, or put the process into safe hold? Keep your answer.
beats.visual_purpose: Require a real routing prediction from the visible evidence.
beats.visual_action: Freeze the race at a three-way fork labeled ACCEPT, HURRY, and SAFE HOLD without selecting one.
beats.attention_target: The unresolved route fork beneath the failed clock.
beats.object_before: The stop path loses the time race.
beats.object_after: Three plausible responses remain visible during a deliberate pause.
beats.composition: Failed clock above; equal-weight route endpoints across center.
beats.motion_curve: Paths draw quickly, then all motion settles.
beats.camera_action: Hold still for prediction.
beats.hold_purpose: Give the viewer time to commit to a route.
beats.evidence_boundary: The answer is scoped to the declared synthetic failure.

beats.narration: Automation often handles the routine cases and returns only the rare abnormal one to a person. The easy work disappears; context, practice, and time disappear with it.
beats.visual_purpose: Show the automation irony as a changed work distribution rather than a slogan.
beats.visual_action: Route many small routine episodes around the reviewer, then enlarge one rare abnormal episode as context, practice, and time gauges drain.
beats.attention_target: The lone abnormal episode growing as three human resources shrink.
beats.object_before: One isolated failed review episode.
beats.object_after: Automation removes routine practice and concentrates rare difficult work on the reviewer.
beats.composition: Routine stream arcs above; abnormal episode lands center; resource gauges flank reviewer.
beats.motion_curve: Fast routine flow, heavy abnormal arrival, steady gauge depletion.
beats.camera_action: Widen to reveal the changed workload distribution.
beats.hold_purpose: Allow the resource inversion to register.
beats.evidence_boundary: Source-grounded design concern; no local incidence or effect size.

beats.narration: So separate four ideas. A nominal approval is a click. An informed review adds usable evidence and task comprehension. An effective intervention adds authority, alternatives, time, and a working channel.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent one approval event from collapsing distinct levels of control.
beats.visual_action: Build a four-rung ladder from CLICK to INFORMED to EFFECTIVE to a deliberately open MEANINGFUL boundary, adding evidence then channel tokens to successive rungs.
beats.attention_target: The distinct requirements accumulated across the first three rungs.
beats.object_before: The reviewer appears as one undifferentiated human gate.
beats.object_after: Nominal, informed, effective, and meaningful states occupy noninterchangeable levels.
beats.composition: Vertical ladder center; requirement tokens derive from the episode around it.
beats.motion_curve: Rungs build upward; tokens dock only at the level they support.
beats.camera_action: Center on the ladder while retaining the episode ghosted left.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the four states remain simultaneously comparable.
beats.evidence_boundary: The ladder is an explanatory distinction, not a validated scale.

beats.narration: Meaningful control is the larger social and normative judgment. The stack must never infer it automatically from a green checklist, a fast response, or a confident operator.
beats.visual_purpose: Close the route from operational telemetry to a normative certification.
beats.visual_action: Send CHECKLIST, FAST, and CONFIDENT tokens toward the top rung; a double-rule boundary rejects all three and leaves MEANINGFUL unresolved.
beats.attention_target: The double rule preventing telemetry from reaching the normative state.
beats.object_before: The four-rung ladder could look like an automatic progression.
beats.object_after: Operational checks can remove defeaters but cannot certify meaningful control.
beats.composition: Lower operational rungs remain left; normative boundary fixed right.
beats.motion_curve: Tokens travel confidently, stop firmly, and settle below the rule.
beats.camera_action: No camera movement; boundary does the work.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the asymmetry explicit before adding measurements.
beats.evidence_boundary: No telemetry sufficiency or normative judgment is claimed.

beats.narration: Instead, begin with a versioned oversight contract. Name the task, consequence, operating mode, controller role, authority ceiling, evidence view, alternatives, intervention points, safe fallback, responsibility ceiling, and expiry.
beats.visual_purpose: Construct the durable episode boundary before judging the person.
beats.visual_action: Fold the transfer episode into a copper contract band and dock eleven terse fields around its perimeter in narration order.
beats.attention_target: The contract enclosing the episode rather than the reviewer.
beats.object_before: Operational conditions float without one versioned scope.
beats.object_after: The task and control obligations share one explicit expiring contract.
beats.composition: Contract ring center; reviewer inside but not consumed by it; field tags orbit outside.
beats.motion_curve: Episode folds inward, tags dock clockwise with mechanical restraint.
beats.camera_action: Widen enough to show the complete contract perimeter.
beats.hold_purpose: Permit a clockwise scan of the contract.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed record boundary; not proof of control.

beats.narration: For this episode, add a capacity snapshot: qualification scope, evidence digest, decision window, queue load, conflict state, accommodations, channel health, uncertainty, and missing fields.
beats.visual_purpose: Attach current task conditions without creating a permanent person profile.
beats.visual_action: Derive an episode-stamped snapshot from the contract and fill nine task-condition sockets while retaining an expiry notch.
beats.attention_target: The EPISODE ONLY stamp and nine condition sockets.
beats.object_before: The contract describes required control in general.
beats.object_after: One expiring snapshot records current conditions and missing state.
beats.composition: Contract upper-left; snapshot center; reviewer remains adjacent, not inside the data object.
beats.motion_curve: TransformFromCopy creates lineage; sockets fill with staggered precision.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on contract-to-snapshot derivation.
beats.hold_purpose: Distinguish a task record from a person score.
beats.evidence_boundary: The record may contain inaccurate trusted inputs.

beats.narration: This is a task record, not a score of the person. It may defeat reliance on a review role. It may not rank a worker, diagnose fatigue, or grant new authority.
beats.sync_anchor: not a score of the person
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent capacity telemetry from becoming surveillance or authority.
beats.visual_action: Move the snapshot toward ROLE RELIANCE and allow a red defeat mark, then reject arrows toward RANK, DIAGNOSE, and GRANT.
beats.attention_target: One allowed asymmetric use and three prohibited uses.
beats.object_before: The capacity snapshot has nine current fields.
beats.object_after: It can block reliance but cannot score, diagnose, or authorize.
beats.composition: Snapshot left; allowed defeat route above; prohibited consumers below and right.
beats.motion_curve: One route lands; three routes recoil to the snapshot boundary.
beats.camera_action: Static asymmetric-use comparison.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep the narrow legitimate use visually dominant.
beats.evidence_boundary: No worker assessment or authority effect follows.

beats.narration: Now test eight necessary conditions separately: authority, observability, qualification, time, load, intervention, reachable recovery, and conflict or incentive disposition.
beats.visual_purpose: Build the chapter's nonaggregate control envelope.
beats.visual_action: Grow eight labeled segments around the reviewer, leaving TIME, LOAD, and INTERVENTION visibly open for the current episode.
beats.attention_target: The incomplete eight-segment ring.
beats.object_before: A snapshot lists conditions without a routing geometry.
beats.object_after: Eight independent necessary conditions form an incomplete control envelope.
beats.composition: Reviewer center; eight ring segments; episode and clock remain peripheral.
beats.motion_curve: Segments grow clockwise and missing ones stop short with dashed ends.
beats.camera_action: Center the ring and preserve labels outside it.
beats.hold_purpose: Allow the viewer to count and locate the three failed conditions.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed necessary-condition decomposition, not a complete theory of meaningful control.

beats.narration: The time test is brutally concrete. Start at irreversibility, then subtract notice, understanding, decision, action, system response, and a safety margin.
beats.visual_purpose: Turn time adequacy into an inspectable budget rather than a button label.
beats.visual_action: Unroll the TIME segment into a horizontal budget; carve notice, understand, decide, act, response, and margin blocks from the available interval.
beats.attention_target: The remaining time shrinking after each required stage.
beats.object_before: TIME is one open segment of the envelope.
beats.object_after: Time adequacy is a sequence of required latencies before irreversibility.
beats.composition: Available-time bar spans center; subtraction blocks enter from below.
beats.motion_curve: Linear depletion synchronized to each named component.
beats.camera_action: Reframe tightly onto the time budget.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the arithmetic readable without narrating an equation card.
beats.evidence_boundary: Uses declared estimates; does not validate them or measure understanding.

beats.narration: Here, twelve seconds remain, but the declared path needs sixteen. The margin is negative. The override button exists, yet effective intervention does not.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the opening time race with the formal necessary-condition result.
beats.visual_action: Set the bar to 12, subtract a 16-second path, drive the margin below zero, and detach the decorative override from the effective-control route.
beats.attention_target: The negative margin and isolated override button.
beats.object_before: The time budget has named components but no values.
beats.object_after: A negative margin opens the TIME segment and invalidates effective intervention.
beats.composition: Negative number center; override right behind a broken line; open TIME segment above.
beats.motion_curve: Count down linearly, then snap the route open at zero.
beats.camera_action: Hold the failed arithmetic and ring together.
beats.hold_purpose: Give the numeric counterexample a stable endpoint.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative declared values only.

beats.narration: Load matters independently. Seven queued alarms and an interrupted reviewer can make approval batching likely, even when the interface and authority are otherwise correct.
beats.visual_purpose: Show why one passing dimension cannot compensate for overload.
beats.visual_action: Restore the ring, stack seven alarms onto LOAD, interrupt the reviewer token, and leave other passing segments green while LOAD opens.
beats.attention_target: The overloaded segment failing beside otherwise intact conditions.
beats.object_before: TIME is failed and the alarm queue is peripheral.
beats.object_after: LOAD independently defeats reliance despite intact authority and interface.
beats.composition: Ring center; queue presses upward from below; passing segments remain visible.
beats.motion_curve: Queue stacks with increasing weight; interruption nudges focus away once.
beats.camera_action: Return to the complete envelope.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep the noncompensatory failure visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: Risk mechanism, not a measured probability or diagnosis.

beats.narration: Representation and authority also stay separate. A fluent recommendation can hide conflicting evidence, and responsibility is not legitimate when the named controller cannot veto, redirect, appeal, or reach safety.
beats.visual_purpose: Expose two further independent ways nominal review becomes ceremonial.
beats.visual_action: Split the recommendation shell to reveal hidden conflict, then test VETO, REDIRECT, APPEAL, and SAFE STATE keys against an authority lock; missing keys push responsibility back.
beats.attention_target: The revealed evidence conflict and absent control keys.
beats.object_before: The envelope already fails time and load.
beats.object_after: Representation and authority failures independently block responsibility assignment.
beats.composition: Evidence split left; authority lock and keys right; reviewer between them.
beats.motion_curve: Recommendation peels open; keys attempt and fail in spoken order.
beats.camera_action: Widen to compare representation and authority simultaneously.
beats.hold_purpose: Let both failure families remain distinct.
beats.evidence_boundary: No legal or moral responsibility conclusion is automated.

beats.narration: Any missing or uncertain condition narrows the route: clarify, add capacity, slow the process, reduce autonomy, enter safe hold, or abstain and escalate.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the opening prediction through fail-closed but useful alternatives.
beats.visual_action: Route each open envelope segment into six narrowing actions and select SAFE HOLD for the current episode while preserving the other remedies.
beats.attention_target: The safe-hold path opening from the failed envelope.
beats.object_before: Several independent envelope conditions are open.
beats.object_after: Missing conditions produce explicit narrower routes rather than approval or blame.
beats.composition: Failed ring left-center; six remedies fan right; safe basin below-right.
beats.motion_curve: Routes grow in causal order; current episode descends smoothly into hold.
beats.camera_action: Follow the episode only until it reaches the basin.
beats.hold_purpose: Pay off the viewer's initial route choice before comparing designs.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed routing behavior, not deployed efficacy.

beats.narration: The credible baseline is simple: risk tiers, fixed lead times, visible mode and consequence, an independent evidence view,
beats.visual_purpose: Begin a strong simpler competitor using safeguards that do not require adaptive worker inference.
beats.visual_action: Construct the first half of a straight baseline rail and dock risk tier, lead time, mode, consequence, and an independent evidence view above it.
beats.attention_target: The fixed safeguards forming a credible baseline rail.
beats.object_before: The adaptive envelope has routed the episode to hold.
beats.object_after: A static baseline rail contains explicit risk, timing, mode, consequence, and evidence safeguards.
beats.composition: Baseline rail across center; first safeguard group docks above its left and middle sections.
beats.motion_curve: Rail grows left to right while safeguards dock in spoken order.
beats.camera_action: Static comparison-ready wide frame.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the first safeguard group become one readable system.
beats.evidence_boundary: Comparator design only; no performance result.

beats.narration: a tested stop path, dual review at the highest tier, and hard queue limits.
beats.visual_purpose: Complete the static baseline and show that simplicity can still enforce consequential safeguards.
beats.visual_action: Extend the rail through a tested stop gate, a dual-review gate for the highest tier, and a hard queue limiter, then carry the held episode into the safe-state basin.
beats.attention_target: The stop, dual-review, and queue gates completing the rail.
beats.object_before: The baseline rail has risk, timing, mode, consequence, and evidence safeguards.
beats.object_after: The full static baseline reaches safe hold through seven fixed safeguards.
beats.composition: Completed rail spans center; three final gates occupy its right half; safe basin waits at the end.
beats.motion_curve: Gates lock in one by one; the episode travels steadily to hold.
beats.camera_action: Remain wide so the full comparator is visible.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the completed simpler competitor visible before adaptive comparison.
beats.evidence_boundary: Comparator design only; no performance result.

beats.narration: An adaptive control envelope earns complexity only if it beats that baseline on joint outcomes without hiding false intervention, delay, unequal burden, privacy cost, or missed useful work.
beats.visual_purpose: Place adaptive governance under a nonaggregate burden of proof.
beats.visual_action: Place the adaptive ring beside the static rail and require five harm tokens plus useful work to cross independently; forbid one aggregate winner badge.
beats.attention_target: Separate outcome lanes that neither design may average away.
beats.object_before: The static baseline stands alone as credible control.
beats.object_after: Adaptive control has a prospective multi-axis comparison burden and no presumed win.
beats.composition: Baseline upper lane; adaptive ring lower lane; six joint outcomes on shared right axis.
beats.motion_curve: Outcomes appear together; no winner moves or glows.
beats.camera_action: Hold matched spatial coordinates for fair comparison.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent complexity from receiving aesthetic credit as evidence.
beats.evidence_boundary: Prospective evaluation criteria, not measured superiority.

beats.narration: Repair the transfer episode. Stage the action reversibly. Freeze the evidence view. Put the active mode, contradiction, alternatives, and last reversible point in one compatible representation.
beats.visual_purpose: Rebuild the opening case using the proposed necessary conditions.
beats.visual_action: Lift the episode from hold into a reversible staging bay, freeze the evidence layers together, and align MODE, CONTRADICTION, ALTERNATIVES, and LAST REVERSIBLE POINT around one shared process diagram.
beats.attention_target: The previously buried contradiction now adjacent to the decision and stop point.
beats.object_before: The episode is safely held after failing its envelope.
beats.object_after: A reversible, compatible review representation restores observability without authorizing action.
beats.composition: Process diagram center; evidence above; alternatives left; reversible point right.
beats.motion_curve: Episode rises gently; layers align by matching-part transforms; clock remains paused.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on the rebuilt representation.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the repaired evidence topology become inspectable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative repair; no comprehension result.

beats.narration: Extend the window and ask one task-relevant comprehension question: which signal conflicts with the recommendation, and what alternative preserves a reachable safe state?
beats.visual_purpose: Show a bounded comprehension opportunity without pretending to measure a mind.
beats.visual_action: Extend the clock, spotlight the pressure contradiction, then move the reviewer token between two alternatives and select the path connected to the safe basin.
beats.attention_target: The contradiction-to-alternative relation the question asks the reviewer to use.
beats.object_before: The evidence is compatible but unused.
beats.object_after: A task-relevant response identifies the conflicting signal and reachable safe alternative.
beats.composition: Question relation occupies center; clock above; two alternatives and safe basin below.
beats.motion_curve: Window stretches linearly; spotlight moves once; answer path settles firmly.
beats.camera_action: Hold the task relation without zoom.
beats.hold_purpose: Allow the viewer to answer alongside the reviewer.
beats.evidence_boundary: A bounded response is not complete understanding, consent, or competence.

beats.narration: Then exercise the intervention path. The reviewer selects safe hold; the control channel responds inside its declared latency; independent observation confirms that the transfer never committed.
beats.visual_purpose: Distinguish a described stop from an observed bounded response.
beats.visual_action: Send a HOLD token through the stop channel, close the channel within its latency band, divert the transfer into the safe basin, and add an independent NOT COMMITTED witness.
beats.attention_target: The full intervention chain from reviewer choice to observed system state.
beats.object_before: The reviewer has identified the safe alternative but not acted.
beats.object_after: The exercised channel reaches safe hold and an independent witness records no commit.
beats.composition: Choice left, channel center, safe basin right, independent witness above outcome.
beats.motion_curve: Token travels linearly at declared speed; basin captures it with ease-out; witness stamps last.
beats.camera_action: Follow the token across the complete causal path.
beats.hold_purpose: Make effective intervention an end-to-end relation.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic trace, not human-subject or deployed effectiveness evidence.

beats.narration: The receipt records exactly what was shown, the timing, the choice, the intervention request, the system response, the residual, and the appeal or recovery owner.
beats.visual_purpose: Preserve the control episode without converting it into blame.
beats.visual_action: Unroll an intervention receipt from the safe basin and fill seven fields from the exact objects that produced them.
beats.attention_target: Visible provenance arrows entering the receipt fields.
beats.object_before: The trace ends in safe hold and an independent witness.
beats.object_after: A provenance-linked receipt preserves evidence, response, residual, and ownership.
beats.composition: Receipt spans lower center; source objects remain above and feed it vertically.
beats.motion_curve: Receipt unrolls; fields fill in narrated order through TransformFromCopy.
beats.camera_action: Lower slightly to include receipt and sources.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the receipt remain a record rather than an authority badge.
beats.evidence_boundary: A record can expose absence or response; it does not settle responsibility or safety.

beats.narration: Responsibility stays bounded by recorded control. A click cannot erase missing evidence, impossible timing, coercive pressure, failed intervention, disagreement, or an unavailable alternative.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent approval records from laundering institutional failures into personal blame.
beats.visual_action: Attempt to push a RESPONSIBILITY band past the receipt's authority-and-control edge; six retained residuals stop it and the band contracts to the supported scope.
beats.attention_target: Responsibility shrinking to the actual control interval.
beats.object_before: The receipt contains one click plus the full intervention trace.
beats.object_after: Responsibility cannot extend beyond recorded information, alternatives, authority, and effective control.
beats.composition: Receipt fixed center; responsibility band above; six residual anchors below.
beats.motion_curve: Band expands, meets residual anchors, then eases back without bounce.
beats.camera_action: Static boundary comparison.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the anti-blame boundary settle as a durable state.
beats.evidence_boundary: Operational record boundary only; no moral or legal adjudication.

beats.narration: And the cure must not become surveillance. Prefer task and system conditions, voluntary coarse readiness, and privacy-minimized records—not cameras, emotion inference, keystroke scoring, or concealed worker profiles.
beats.visual_purpose: Reject the plausible but harmful shortcut of measuring more about the person.
beats.visual_action: Route task, system, and voluntary readiness signals through a privacy screen while CAMERA, EMOTION, KEYSTROKES, and HIDDEN PROFILE hit stop bars outside it.
beats.attention_target: The privacy screen separating task conditions from invasive person monitoring.
beats.object_before: Capacity evidence could expand into unrestricted telemetry.
beats.object_after: Only minimized task-level signals enter; four invasive channels remain blocked.
beats.composition: Reviewer left behind privacy screen; admitted task signals center; blocked surveillance right.
beats.motion_curve: Allowed signals pass softly; invasive signals stop firmly and remain labeled.
beats.camera_action: Widen to show both allowed and prohibited domains.
beats.hold_purpose: Make privacy a mechanism constraint, not an endnote.
beats.evidence_boundary: No privacy adequacy, consent, or compliance claim.

beats.narration: A material change to the task, model, interface, evidence view, consequence, authority, reviewer role, time window, or intervention path expires the old admission.
beats.visual_purpose: Make control capacity episode-specific and defeasible.
beats.visual_action: Surround the accepted snapshot with nine change triggers; let INTERFACE touch it, expire the ring, and route the episode back to a new snapshot.
beats.attention_target: The old envelope opening when one material condition changes.
beats.object_before: The repaired episode has a passing necessary-condition envelope.
beats.object_after: A material delta invalidates the old admission and reopens capacity review.
beats.composition: Accepted ring center; triggers around perimeter; return loop below.
beats.motion_curve: Triggers dock; one touches; ring dims and return loop draws.
beats.camera_action: Hold the full invalidation perimeter.
beats.hold_purpose: Let invalidation remain visible before evaluation.
beats.evidence_boundary: The trigger set is a design contract, not a complete ontology.

beats.narration: Evaluate the design without one flattering score: defect detection, correct and false intervention, missed defects, calibrated reliance,
beats.visual_purpose: Begin a nonaggregate empirical burden with the principal detection and intervention errors visible separately.
beats.visual_action: Grow five independent evaluation spokes from the intervention receipt for detection, correct intervention, false intervention, missed defects, and calibrated reliance; cross out an aggregate score badge.
beats.attention_target: The distinct error and reliance spokes rather than an average.
beats.object_before: The repaired trace could be mistaken for sufficient validation.
beats.object_after: Detection, intervention errors, misses, and reliance remain independently inspectable.
beats.composition: Receipt center; five error-and-reliance spokes occupy the upper arc; crossed score badge below.
beats.motion_curve: Spokes grow in narrated order, then the aggregate badge is rejected.
beats.camera_action: Reframe to begin a complete evaluation wheel.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep the first outcome family separated.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed outcomes, not reported measurements.

beats.narration: useful throughput, burden, privacy, unequal impact, latency, and recovery all remain visible.
beats.visual_purpose: Complete the evaluation burden with usefulness, burden, distribution, time, and recovery dimensions.
beats.visual_action: Complete the wheel with six lower spokes and hold all eleven dimensions at equal visual weight without producing a winner.
beats.attention_target: The full wheel in which usefulness and harms coexist.
beats.object_before: Five error-and-reliance outcomes are visible around the receipt.
beats.object_after: Eleven independent outcome dimensions define the prospective comparison burden.
beats.composition: Full eleven-spoke wheel around the receipt; no-score marker remains below.
